inlines.v: BILL'ET, noun [dim. of bill; ] A small paper or note in writing, used for various purposes; sometimes it is a short letter, addressed to some person; sometimes a ticket directing soldiers at what house to lodge. In heraldry, billet is a bearing in the form of a long square.
